title: Frame Return Refunds at Northgate Optical
content:
**Northgate Optical frame return refund.** In an in-lab cancellation the frame goes back to stock, and its frame return refund is booked as one refund credit against the frame charge, returned to the original tender.

The frame return refund belongs to an eyewear job cancelled while it is in the lab. The credit is posted against the job's frame charge; whatever part of the frame charge is not refunded stays billed.

## Booking the refund: `refund_frame_to_stock_fae456d1`

**Capability.** The tool books the refund of an eyewear job's frame when the frame goes back to stock. One call adds one cancellation refund credit against the job's frame charge, with the amount given, dated today, returned to the member's original tender; whatever is not refunded stays billed. The credit does not earn or take back Annual Reward.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it (`unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`) and then calls it (`call_agent_discoverable_tool`).

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `optical_order_id` | the reference number of the eyewear job whose frame is refunded | identifier, read from the eyewear job lookup |
| `customer_id` | the customer reference number of the member who owns the eyewear job | identifier, read from the customer profile lookup |
| `source_txn_id` | the reference number of the job's frame charge being refunded | identifier, read from the job's charge and credit lookup |
| `frame_refund_usd` | the amount of the frame charge refunded, in USD | plain number, no currency sign, 2 decimal places, not below 0; rounded half-to-even to 2 decimal places on booking |

**Return.** A receipt with `optical_txn_id` (the reference number of the frame refund credit), `optical_order_id` (the job), `source_txn_id` (the frame charge refunded), `amount` (the refund, USD with 2 decimal places), `credit_reason` (always `cancellation_refund`) and `status` (`posted` when the refund is on the ledger).

## Reference notes

- The refund credit points back to the frame charge of the job and appears against that charge on the job's charge and credit lookup, with the cancellation refund reason.
- A vision plan frame allowance already credited against the frame charge is a different credit, with the insurance allowance reason; it is not a frame return refund.
